text:
mike: forwarding support case from NorthMall. They run Dedicated and want streaming chat responses + tool calls forwarded to their webhook as discrete JSON frames so they can render incremental checkout suggestions. ticket: https://northmall.example/issue/9001

ara: are they blocked today? timeline?

mike: they're blocked for a new live-cart feature. They need first partial within ~180ms and tool outputs as separate frames. Prefer opt-in per-project flag.

sophia: engineering quick take: we can reuse existing token stream plumbing but need an envelope for tool frames and a short-lived resume cursor. Key constraints: - no duplicate side-effects on retry - opt-in so hosted customers unaffected - simple schema for pilot

ram: sample pilot frame (NDJSON): {"frame":"tool","tool":"price_lookup","id":"f-42","seq":2,"cursor":"cur_7","data":{"partial":true,"price":1999}}
This stays single-line and easy to parse. cursor is a short token we can GC.

ara: product acceptance (pilot) proposal: - opt-in Dedicated flag - NDJSON frames with seq+cursor - resume cursor TTL=45s - at-least-once delivery + dedupe guidance in docs - simple SDK snippet and telemetry (frames, resumes, dupes)

mike: what are the dev estimates?

sophia: MVP (emit frames + forward to webhook + cursor store ttl) = 2 engs x 3 weeks. Server-side rehydrate + full resume = another 2-3 sprints and infra storage. Replay-safe wrappers for non-idempotent tools will add effort per-tool.

ram: risks: stateful cursor introduces GC/storage; webhooks flaky -> backoff + DLQ; dedupe mostly on customer side unless we add replay wrappers. Also security review if frames contain PI.

ara: PM decision: list as P2 pilot focused on customer retention. owner: sophia (eng), ara (PM). Pilot with NorthMall only; evaluate hosted later.

mike: action items: sophia to draft RFC and sample NDJSON by EOW; ara to write pilot success metrics and acceptance tests; ram to scope infra spike for cursor store.

eng-bot: created PROD-1729 "dedicated-webhook-json-frames-pilot (NorthMall)" assigned to sophia, labels: customer-pilot,p2,webhook-streaming

sophia: will include replay guidance and example client reassembly code in RFC.

ara: pilot success metrics suggestion: first-frame latency <250ms, resume success rate >90%, duplicates <1 per 10k, NorthMall UX signoff after 2 weeks.

mike: good. move to backlog with above owners. please add any SRE/legal flags on the RFC thread. :+1:
